apps.name: Plezy
apps.subtitle: Cross-platform Plex & Jellyfin Client
apps.localizedDescription: A modern video client for Plex and Jellyfin media servers.

versions.localizedDescription:
## New features

- Live TV recording on Jellyfin and Emby
- Match Content Resolution on Android TV
- FFmpeg demuxes every container on Android
- Anchored grouping, filter, and sort menus on desktop
- Cmd+, / Ctrl+, opens settings
- Full details sheet
